title: Latency and ONNX parity
summary: Exports the checkpoint to ONNX, checks its parity with PyTorch, and times it against the 97 ms budget.
does: The latency flow's parts (tools/latency.py): gpu exports best.pt to ONNX, checks ONNX Runtime and PyTorch on CPU and GPU against PyTorch on the CPU over validation crops (the same labels, probabilities within 1e-5), and times them; cpu times both on CPU threads; sweep runs a recorded sweep through the frame path with its overlay (tools/sweep.py). No latency is quoted without parity for the same file. The word latency queues the jobs; the sandbox counts the GPU job (grid/latency-sweep.sbatch: 8 CPUs, 32 GB, 1 h 30).

outputs.name: metrics
outputs.what: Parity, latency and the sweep's overlay.

nondeterminism: Timings vary from run to run and card to card, which is what is measured; parity is held to 1e-5 on the same file.

generic.why: The sweep input is a clip of 2-D frames (tools/sweep.py) and the network reads 2-D crops; a volume has no sweep to play.

today.note: the word latency queues its jobs for one v1 run
